# Galoria AI

> Galoria is a Windows-only AI photo organizer that categorizes image files locally. Users can review proposed destinations before applying moves. Verified supported systems: Windows 10, Windows 11.

## Core pages

- [AI Photo Organizer for Windows](https://galoria-ai.github.io/ai-photo-organizer/): Organize mixed photo libraries on Windows with local AI, preview-first review, and a folder plan you can approve before anything moves.
- [Photo Organizer for Windows](https://galoria-ai.github.io/photo-organizer-windows/): Sort photo folders on Windows with local AI, straightforward preview steps, and destinations that help you browse mixed image libraries later.
- [Automatic Photo Organizer](https://galoria-ai.github.io/automatic-photo-organizer/): Automatically organize photo folders on Windows with local AI, previewed folder moves, and safer cleanup for mixed image libraries.
- [Automatic Photo Sorting](https://galoria-ai.github.io/automatic-photo-sorting/): Sort screenshots, exports, and mixed image folders automatically on Windows with local AI and a preview before any move happens.
- [Windows Photo Organizer](https://galoria-ai.github.io/windows-photo-organizer/): A Windows photo organizer for local image libraries, screenshot folders, and mixed downloads that need a preview-first sort order.
- [Offline AI Photo Organizer](https://galoria-ai.github.io/offline-ai-photo-organizer/): Compare local Windows photo organization with cloud services by privacy, preview control, and whether your images need to leave the device.
- [Galoria vs Cloud AI Photo Organizers](https://galoria-ai.github.io/photo-organizer-vs-cloud/): Compare local Windows photo sorting with cloud-based AI organizers by privacy, control, setup effort, and whether image uploads are required.
- [Automatic vs Manual Photo Organization](https://galoria-ai.github.io/photo-organizer-vs-manual/): Compare automatic and manual photo organization by setup time, review, control, scale, and whether you want repeated cleanup work.
